newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Jan 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Trade on Amman bourse declined 40.7 percent last year, chairman says.
- Abu Dhabi Gas Liquefaction Co announces intention to raise production to more than eight million tonnes this year.
- Qatar, Bahrain to sign an agreement on Sunday to normalise relations strained over a territorial dispute.
- Qatar and international firms sign contract to build a petrochemical project at a cost of $500 million.
- United Arab Emirates' foreign trade in the second quarter of last year stood at 26 billion dirhams, report shows.
